description:
Turns a reference into an identifier and an official link:
statute or decree number ("91-647", "loi n° 78-17") → the text;
identifier (LEGIARTI, LEGITEXT, JORFTEXT, CETATEXT, JURITEXT, ECLI,
CELEX of a judgment or of a text, HUDOC) → URL at the source;
European article ("art. 8 CEDH", "267 TFUE", "P1-1", "art. 17 RGPD",
"article 3 de la directive 93/13") → official link and the
get_law_article call. A decision number is read with
get_decision instead (the error gives the exact call).

Examples:
  resolve_reference(reference="loi n° 91-647")
  resolve_reference(reference="LEGIARTI000032041571")

Args:
    reference: text number or identifier
    legitext: parent LEGITEXT (for a LEGIARTI of a text outside the codes)
    date: YYYY-MM-DD (article version in the URL)

legitext.description: parent LEGITEXT (for a LEGIARTI of a text outside the codes)
legitext.title: Legitext

name: resolve_reference
